title: Experience register row
description: What a map shows for one node: an action, touchpoint, channel, expectation, thought, pain, workaround, emotion or question, with its evidence. Rows have no IDs; (node_id, row_type, text) is unique. The register is optional in a journey system. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: node_id, row_type and text (the row itself and its identity) and evidence_status (every experience claim carries provenance; unknown when not assessed). evidence_ids may be empty for hypothesis and unknown rows. valence is required on emotion rows and empty on all others, a conditional rule the validator enforces.

text.description: The action, expectation, thought, pain, workaround, emotion or question, in the actor's terms; mark quotes as quotes.

valence.description: Emotion rows only: -2 (very negative) to 2 (very positive).
